evidenceBoundary: The exact CC BY 4.0 v1 release was retrieved and fingerprinted. A privacy-preserving aggregate probe verified 10,132 machine rows and 22 complete rActualTemp traces. Manufacturer documentation directly supports the Heating.sv_Zone*.rActualTemp pattern as heating-zone actual/real temperature in degrees Celsius while warning that zone affiliation is machine-specific. Sixteen exact-pattern channels therefore contribute 162,112 accepted measured time-series values. HeatingOven1, other machine fields, cavity pressure/temperature columns and ultrasonic RMS remain excluded until their source-specific unit/role contracts are sufficient. The source remains one already-profiled dataset family; family count does not change.
